test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

SOCCER ∶ OSFFRE ∶∶ ROLLER ∶ OROORE ∶∶ TOPPER ∶ ?
solution: In the above question, following pattern is followed, [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/K0h2RtFzuRqvIcV1Xik9OsSf9OceKBnbYp76K8BZgFfZ6-XKlWyJqGiTRHUY7RzvhFKNFmCvgUK1AxsUMh3u5Bu1CG1uWfheqO334hViVQqj_6DIXppL7eBtcLqCaoowjKWUqwlh8UbEi-DBDyIPnw] Ist and 2nd letters interchange their position, 5th and 6th letters interchange their position and 3 letters are added to 3rd and 4th letters. SOCCER = OSFFRE (S, O interchange their position, E,R interchange their position and C= 3 + 3 = 6, 6th letter = F, come in place of 3rd and 4th letter)
